title: Teleport To Mouse
code:
-- Axiom library: teleport to mouse
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hit = plr:GetMouse().Hit
        char:MoveTo(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
    end
end)
print("Press T to teleport to your mouse")

title: ESP Boxes
code:
-- Axiom library: simple 2D ESP
local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local boxes = {}
local function draw(p)
    local char = p.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local root = char.HumanoidRootPart
    local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
    if not onScreen then if boxes[p] then boxes[p].Visible = false end return end
    local b = boxes[p]
    if not b then
        b = Instance.new("Frame")
        b.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
        b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
        s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
        s.Thickness = 1.5
        boxes[p] = b
    end
    b.Visible = true
    b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 90)
    b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X - 25, pos.Y - 45)
end
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.05) do
        for _, p in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= plr then pcall(draw, p) end
        end
    end
end)
print("ESP enabled")

title: FPS Counter
code:
-- Axiom library: FPS counter
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(130, 26)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 8, 18)
label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
label.TextSize = 14
local frames = 0
local acc = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    frames += 1
    acc += dt
    if acc >= 1 then
        label.Text = "FPS: " .. frames
        frames = 0
        acc = 0
    end
end)
print("FPS counter enabled")
